title: 给下拉起对名字
summary: 往下展开的面板不是同一种东西。先按提交规则选模型（单选 / 多选 / 分组 / 级联 / 分割按钮 / 巨型导航 / 日期），再谈外观。
summaryEn: A panel that opens downward is not one widget. Pick the model by what it commits — single, multi, grouped, cascader, split button, mega nav, or dates — then talk about the skin.
asks: 往下展开的面板提交什么？
asksEn: What does this downward panel commit?
